## 2. Core Pillars & Competencies

### A. Artificial Intelligence & Generative Media
- **Prompt Engineering & Iterative Art Direction:** Precision control over prompt weights, composition parameters, lighting conditions, and material properties.
- **Commercial Studio Emulation:** Exploring fluted glass caustics, softbox reflections, micro-textures, and high-end flacon product photography.
- **AI-Assisted Video Production:** Conceptualizing storyboards, generating sequenced video clips, synchronizing pacing with sound design, and producing commercial teaser films.

### B. Visual & Brand Design
- **Luxury Brand Systems:** Editorial typography, restrained colour palettes (obsidian, brushed gold, slate), strict grid alignment, and intentional negative space.
- **Advertising Layouts:** Headline hierarchy, commercial storytelling, and brand book cohesion.
- **Tools:** Canva, Figma, Adobe Suite concepts, Typography Systems.

### C. Data Storytelling & Business Intelligence
- **Power BI:** Data modelling, star schemas, DAX measures, KPI scorecards, interactive cross-filtering, and executive visual reporting.
- **Advanced Microsoft Excel:** Dynamic array formulas, multi-table pivot analysis, conditional formatting heatmaps, and financial/operational scenario models.

### D. Game Design & Creative Web Engineering
- **Interactive Web Systems:** Three.js 3D viewport canvas, custom procedural starfield and grid geometry, custom shaders, and WebGL rendering.
- **Gameplay Architecture:** State management, hit detection, audio synthesis using the Web Audio API, interactive mechanics, and procedural reward loops.
- **"Echoes of the Grid" Quest:** A built-in interactive game experience where users navigate a glowing purification drone to resolve anomalies across a decaying grid matrix.

---

## 3. Detailed Project Case Studies

### Case Study 01: VELORÉ — Luxury Beyond Glass (Featured Brand Case Study)
- **Classification:** Brand Identity & Advertisement System
- **Status:** Complete
- **Tools:** Canva, AI Image Generation, Typography, Layout Design
- **Overview:** A complete brand identity and advertisement system built for a fictional luxury fragrance house based in Paris. Designed to demonstrate how AI-assisted visual generation and classical luxury typography coalesce into a unified commercial presentation.
- **Challenge:** Creating a visual identity that feels undeniably expensive, restrained, and coherent across advertisements, physical packaging studies, and digital assets without resorting to generic luxury tropes.
- **Approach:** Established a strict typographic system (Manrope display paired with DM Mono technical labeling) and a high-contrast dark palette (black slate, amber caustics, muted metallics). Generated photorealistic flacon variations with AI, fine-tuned reflection caustics, and composited them into editorial advertising spreads.
- **Deliverables:** Campaign visual posters (e.g., *VELORÉ NOIRÉ Eau de Parfum* on wet slate), product packaging mockups, studio lighting studies (*VELORÉ LUMIÈRE*), and advertising print assets.

### Case Study 02: Brand Advertisement Design (AUREVÉ Campaign)
- **Classification:** Editorial Graphic Design
- **Status:** Complete
- **Tools:** Canva, Typography, Grid Layout
- **Overview:** Standalone advertising layouts developed for flagship consumer electronics and lifestyle launches.
- **Challenge:** Communicating product personality and sonic elevation in a single still frame using typography and structural spatial balance alone.
- **Approach:** Designed cosmic light rings and particle halos around the hero headphone subject, framing the layout with restrained subheadings and strong focal lines.
- **Deliverables:** Launch advertisement poster featuring the tagline *"Sound. Elevated."*

### Case Study 03: AI-Generated Product Photos & Macro Material Studies
- **Classification:** Generative AI & Commercial Photography
- **Status:** Complete
- **Tools:** AI Image Generation, Prompt Engineering, Digital Retouching
- **Overview:** Studio-grade product photography series replicating high-end commercial camera rigs and macro lenses.
- **Challenge:** Achieving uniform light direction, believable reflections on metallic surfaces, and authentic water droplet physics across distinct generation batches.
- **Approach:** Iterated systematically on lighting descriptors (45° softbox, edge rim lighting, wet obsidian slate), filtering out artifacts and color-grading the chosen outputs to ensure uniform portfolio cohesion.
- **Deliverables:** Fluted glass flacon studies, macro brass atomizer nozzle shots with directional mist illumination, and floating headphone compositions.

### Case Study 04: Power BI Executive Dashboard
- **Classification:** Business Intelligence & Analytics
- **Status:** Complete
- **Tools:** Power BI, Data Modelling, DAX, Visual Hierarchy
- **Overview:** An interactive corporate analytics dashboard tracking sales velocity, conversion rates, and gross margin across product lines and geographic zones.
- **Challenge:** Preventing information overload while providing immediate high-level clarity and deep slice-and-dice capability for decision makers.
- **Approach:** Structured the data into relational tables, calculated dynamic measures, and laid out cards in an inverted pyramid hierarchy (high-level KPIs at the top, trend lines in the center, granular breakdown charts at the bottom).
- **Deliverables:** Responsive dashboard with time-period filters, category slicers, and dynamic revenue metrics.

### Case Study 05: Excel Data Analysis & Operations Model
- **Classification:** Quantitative Analysis & Data Modelling
- **Status:** Complete
- **Tools:** Microsoft Excel, Pivot Tables, Complex Formulas, Conditional Formatting
- **Overview:** Structured data audit and operational workbook processing thousands of sample retail entries.
- **Challenge:** Automating calculation pipelines, identifying category outliers, and transforming disorganized transactional records into actionable management reports without manual recalculations.
- **Approach:** Utilized `INDEX/MATCH`, `XLOOKUP`, nested aggregations, dynamic pivot tables, and subtle color scales to isolate anomalies and seasonality.
- **Deliverables:** Multi-tab financial and operational summary sheet with automated metric summaries.

### Case Study 06: AI Video Creation (AUREVÉ V1 & VINCERO Films)
- **Classification:** AI Cinematography & Video Editing
- **Status:** In Progress / Active Pipeline
- **Tools:** Generative Video Models, Non-Linear Editing, Sound Design
- **Overview:** High-impact commercial teaser films showcasing consumer computing hardware (*AUREVÉ V1*) and mechanical horology (*VINCERO*).
- **Challenge:** Overcoming temporal inconsistency inherent in AI video generations to maintain continuity, believable physics, and rhythm.
- **Approach:** Pre-visualized shots via detailed style frames, generated clips with prompt camera motion cues, stitched cuts tightly to percussion, and layered ambient mechanical and atmospheric audio.
- **Deliverables:** Two video campaigns with custom poster art and video teaser previews.

---

## 4. Interactive Experiences & Technical Architecture

### Portfolio Website Architecture
- **Single-Page Application (SPA):** Built with semantic HTML5, modern CSS3 variables/flexbox/grid, and vanilla JavaScript (zero heavy framework dependencies for maximum performance and near-instant load times).
- **Interactive 3D Boot Sequence:** Includes a boot diagnostic sequence, 3D canvas calibration, and interactive progress counter that transitions users smoothly into the portfolio.
- **Three.js Visual Canvas:** Real-time WebGL rendering of dynamic particle waves, coordinates, and responsive pointer interactivity.
- **Web Audio Engine:** Built-in programmatic audio synthesizer generating harmonic tones, click feedback, and ambient audio cues without external audio asset weight.
- **Built-in Quest ("Echoes of the Grid"):** Full interactive canvas mini-game built inside the portfolio where players navigate a node to purify corrupted grid clusters.
- **Privacy & Consent System:** Fully compliant with global data privacy standards, featuring a zero-dependency cookie consent manager and persistent local preferences.
